messages:
alex: FYI customer FinSys asks for a machine-readable SIEM feed of all KMS key-rotation + RBAC admin events for the last 90d. They want schema + a one-time export and an option for streaming. Can we deliver without exposing any key material? cc @maria @sam

maria: Do they want historical export only or streaming into Splunk? Also which fields are must-have for their SOC? (they mentioned Splunk HEC and a csv/jsonl ingest)

sam: We can do both. Historical export from audit-store as JSONL + a Splunk HEC stream for realtime. Important constraints: never include private key material, never include raw AES key bytes, and tenant-identifiers need pseudonymization if they consider them PII.

sam: Proposed minimal schema (we can expand):
```json
{\n  \"event_type\": \"string\",        // e.g. kms.key.rotate, rbac.role.grant, rbac.role.revoke\n  \"timestamp\": \"ISO8601\",\n  \"tenant_id\": \"string (pseudonymized)\",\n  \"user\": \"string\",\n  \"user_role\": \"string\",\n  \"action\": \"string\",\n  \"key_id\": \"string (hashed id)\",\n  \"rotation_version\": \"optional\",\n  \"request_id\": \"string\",\n  \"audit_seq\": \"int\"\n}\n```

sam: For pseudonymization we suggest HMAC(key=rotation-salt, tenant_id) and return first 16 chars, plus a salt_id so customer can validate using our attestation. We can also include `key_fingerprint` (sha256 of public wrapping key) but not any private material.

katie: +1 on HMAC approach. Also ask Legal: do we need consent before returning tenant-related metadata? For most enterprise customers behavioral/tenant ids are fine but emails/employees must be redacted. Please strip any email addresses in the `user` field or replace with service-account names only.

sam: Noted. We'll normalize `user` to canonical service/account names and replace email-like strings with `redacted_email`. Example export line:
```json
{"event_type":"kms.key.rotate","timestamp":"2026-02-10T14:23:11Z","tenant_id":"hmac:4f3a1b2c","user":"svc-kms-rotations","user_role":"platform-admin","action":"rotate","key_id":"hk:sha256:ab12...","rotation_version":"v3","request_id":"req-9f12","audit_seq":3456}
```

infra-bot: export job queued: /jobs/export_audit --from 2025-11-01 --to 2026-02-10 --format jsonl --redact=email --pseudonymize=tenant --salt_id=rot-salt-2026 (job 4521) :hourglass:

maria: For Splunk streaming we need HEC token + index. Sam, can you add a tiny example curl client so FinSys can validate?

sam: sure. Example HEC post (redacted token):
```bash
curl -k https://splunk-fin.example.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk REDACTED' -d '{"event": <jsonline>} '
```

sam: Also attaching plan for attestation: provide signed manifest (RSASSA-PSS) listing export parameters, salt_id, job id, and SHA256 of exported file. We sign with our audit signing key and publish the public cert for verification.

katie: Legal wants copy of the manifest and cert before we share with customer. I'll loop them in.

alex: OK action items: 1) infra to run export job 4521 (maria/infra) 2) sam to prepare JSON schema + sample HEC curl + attestation plan (by EOD) 3) katie to confirm redaction/legal ok and confirm what PII to strip (tomorrow morning). Delivery target to FinSys: 2026-02-12. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

devsec-bot: Incident note template: if any anomalies found in exported events, flag as SEC-EXPORT-ANOMALY and escalate to oncall.

alex: I'll update the customer thread after legal sign-off.
